tagline: 美能达微型相机，1966 年发布
description: 美能达于1966年推出的微型相机。配备Rokkor 1:2.8/20 mm with 4 elements, a sliding door with an additional portrait element can be shifted into the position in front of the lens。快门速度Speeds of flash synchronized shifter shutter set manually between 1/30 and 1/250 sec.。使用Minolta 16 mm film with ISO speeds 25-400。

specs.胶片/画幅: Minolta 16 mm film with ISO speeds 25-400
specs.镜头: Rokkor 1:2.8/20 mm with 4 elements, a sliding door with an additional portrait element can be shifted into the position in front of the lens
specs.快门: Speeds of flash synchronized shifter shutter set manually between 1/30 and 1/250 sec.
specs.曝光测光: coupled selenium meter, match needle exposure setting system
specs.英文简介: The Minolta-16 MG was an exciting item of Minolta's subminiature camera series.
